source.title: NASA SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km Surface and Root Zone Soil Moisture (SPL4SMGP v008), via AppEEARS

note: Calendar-year mean of the monthly standardized anomaly of SMAP L4 root-zone soil moisture (0-100 cm, m3/m3) at the field's 9 km cell, vs the same calendar month over 2015-2025 (0 = normal, -1 = one standard deviation drier). One cell (row 0, col 0), not an 11x11 neighbourhood. Our same-season percentile per year (mean): 2015 26, 2016 60, 2017 65, 2018 44, 2019 71, 2020 31, 2021 27, 2022 25, 2023 70, 2024 61, 2025 64, 2026 61. 2026 is partial (through 2026-11-10).
